# FINAL COMPREHENSIVE REPORT: Population Difference Between Largest and Smallest Washington County Seats by Land Area ## FINAL ANSWER **736,455** This is the population difference between Seattle (the largest county seat by land area) and Cathlamet (the smallest county seat by land area) in Washington state, based on official 2020 Census data. --- ## COMPLETE WORKING HISTORY AND METHODOLOGY ### Step 1: Identification of All Washington State County Seats **Objective:** Compile a complete list of all 39 county seats in Washington state. **Method:** Searched for authoritative sources listing Washington's counties and their official county seats. **Sources Used:** - CCCarto Washington County Seats Map (https://www.cccarto.com/countyseats/washington/) - Wikipedia's "List of counties in Washington" - Washington Courts directory **Result:** Successfully identified all 39 counties and their county seats: 1. Adams - Ritzville 2. Asotin - Asotin 3. Benton - Prosser 4. Chelan - Wenatchee 5. Clallam - Port Angeles 6. Clark - Vancouver 7. Columbia - Dayton 8. Cowlitz - Kelso 9. Douglas - Waterville 10. U.S. Census Bureau 2020 Gazetteer Files - File: 2020_Gaz_place_national.txt - URL: https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2020_Gazetteer/2020_Gaz_place_national.zip - Field Used: ALAND_SQMI (land area in square miles, excluding water) **Complete Land Area Results (all 39 county seats):** | County Seat | Land Area (sq mi) | |-------------|-------------------| | Seattle | 83.830 | | Spokane | 68.760 | | Tacoma | 49.714 | | Vancouver | 48.738 | | Pasco | 33.958 | | Everett | 33.191 | | Bellingham | 28.141 | | Yakima | 27.805 | | Olympia | 18.221 | | Walla Walla | 13.846 | | Mount Vernon | 12.298 | | Wenatchee | 10.576 | | Port Angeles | 10.711 | | Ephrata | 10.437 | | Montesano | 10.376 | | Port Orchard | 9.644 | | Kelso | 8.135 | | Ellensburg | 7.706 | | Port Townsend | 6.942 | | Shelton | 5.816 | | Chehalis | 5.807 | | Prosser | 4.657 | | Colfax | 3.779 | | Colville | 3.084 | | Goldendale | 2.960 | | Friday Harbor | 2.182 | | Okanogan | 2.008 | | Stevenson | 1.927 | | Pomeroy | 1.776 | | Ritzville | 1.750 | | Davenport | 1.667 | | South Bend | 1.641 | | Newport | 1.468 | | Dayton | 1.441 | | Republic | 1.420 | | Coupeville | 1.270 | | Asotin | 1.142 | | Waterville | 0.865 | | Cathlamet | 0.506 | **Key Findings:** - U.S. Census Bureau official CSV file - Document: "places-population-2010-to-2020-csv.csv" - Title: "Population Change for Incorporated Places With 2020 Census Populations of 50,000 or More in the United States: 2010 to 2020" - URL: https://www.census.gov/content/dam/Census/newsroom/press-kits/2021/redistricting/places-population-2010-to-2020-csv.csv - Data Point: Population April 1, 2020: 737,015 **Verification:** - data.census.gov DECENNIALPL2020.P1 table confirms 737,015 - Washington State Office of Financial Management official files confirm 737,015 - Multiple Census Bureau sources consistently show this figure **Geography Confirmation:** - Incorporated city in King County, Washington - Not a CDP, ZIP code, or other geography type #### Cathlamet town, Washington **Population: 560** **Primary Source:** - Washington State Office of Financial Management - Document: "April 1 Population of Cities, Towns and Counties - Used for Allocation of Selected State Revenues" - URL: https://ofm.wa.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/default/files/public/dataresearch/pop/april1/ofm_april1_population_final.pdf - Data Point: Census 2020: 560 (under Wahkiakum County) - Note: Document explicitly states "The 2020 populations are, with a few exceptions, equal to the federal census PL 94-171 counts." **Verification:** - Wikipedia confirms: "The population was 560 at the 2020 census" - Census population estimate files show slight variations (561, 563) due to post-Census Count Question Resolution adjustments, but the original 2020 Census count was 560 **Geography Confirmation:** - Incorporated town in Wahkiakum County, Washington - Not a CDP, ZIP code, or other geography type ### Step 4: Final Calculation **Calculation:** - Seattle population (2020 Census): 737,015 - Cathlamet population (2020 Census): 560 - **Difference: 737,015 - 560 = 736,455** --- ## DATA QUALITY AND VERIFICATION ### Completeness ✓ All 39 Washington state county seats identified ✓ Land area data obtained for all 39 county seats ✓ Population data verified from official Census sources ✓ No missing or incomplete data points ### Data Sources Authority ✓ Land areas: Official 2020 Census Gazetteer Files (ALAND_SQMI field) ✓ Populations: 2020 Decennial Census P.L. 94-171 Redistricting Data ✓ All data represents April 1, 2020 official counts ✓ All sources are U.S. Census Bureau or state agencies using Census data ### Geographic Accuracy ✓ All county seats are incorporated places (cities or towns) ✓ No unincorporated CDPs in the list ✓ Land area excludes water bodies (ALAND vs. total area) ✓ 2020 Census boundaries used consistently ### No Ambiguities Found - Clear identification of largest (Seattle) and smallest (Cathlamet) by land area - No ties requiring resolution - Straightforward interpretation of "by land area of the county seat" - Population figures are unambiguous official counts --- ## SUPPORTING STATISTICS ### Land Area Context - Seattle's land area (83.830 sq mi) is 165.6 times larger than Cathlamet's (0.506 sq mi) - Seattle represents 15.5% of the total land area of all 39 county seats combined - Eight county seats have land areas under 2 square miles - The median county seat land area is approximately 5.8 square miles ### Population Context - Seattle's population (737,015) is 1,316 times larger than Cathlamet's (560) - Seattle is the most populous city in Washington state - Cathlamet is one of the smallest incorporated towns in Washington - The population difference (736,455) exceeds the total population of many Washington counties --- ## CONCLUSION Based on comprehensive data collection from official U.S. Census Bureau sources, the population difference between the largest county seat by land area (Seattle, 83.830 sq mi, population 737,015) and the smallest county seat by land area (Cathlamet, 0.506 sq mi, population 560) in Washington state as of the 2020 Census is: **736,455** This answer is definitive with no alternative interpretations, ambiguities, or uncertainties.
